coding_convention: Zero-based H-suppressed input graph indices. Use non-chiral atom-pair atom codes. The pair kernel uses the actual unweighted graph shortest-path distance. Current packed representation stores distance in5low bits,smaller atom code above it,and larger atom code after9more atom-code bits:score=distance+(smaller_code<<5)+(larger_code<<14). Candidate exported codes are untrusted.
scope: A molecular graph-feature certificate,not a3Ddistance,atom identity hash or experimental interaction measurement.
